msg: combined review ADR 0026 P6 @ 76142c2 — REJECT for landing (one blocker), design otherwise ACCEPT. Measured: TIC_STORE=git with an unroutable remote, EVERY 'tics claim-check' takes ~10.2 s (3/3 runs, no backoff); guard-edit-scope calls claim-check + claim-owner per edit -> ~20 s per edit on a dead host. Causes: a failed fetch sets no stamp (retries every read), and loadTics runs per worktree (loadTicsAll) so one process can fetch twice. Fix (red first): (1) an ATTEMPT stamp throttles fetches on any outcome (success stamp stays for freshness), (2) fetch at most once per process per bus dir, (3) red: with a dead remote, 3 consecutive reads after the first complete in < 1 s each and still exit 0. Answers: Q1 emit-side stamp — defer, record as known gap; Q2 back off — yes, that is the blocker fix; masking — keep exactly-once pinned on --here, no change to the default path. Good catch rejecting the touch -t hack (an implementer bending the write path to pass a flawed test).
